browser.method: Actual in-app browser interactions and screenshots at a narrow viewport
checks: Three independent tabs: Tasks, Test, Results
Single-run execution details hidden on Tasks and Test even after opening a historical trace
Named custom task created, renamed, reloaded, archived and restored; revisions 1 through 4 observed
Task with no saved current-revision baseline cannot start
Single mode chooses one framework, service and task
Matrix mode independently selects axes; 2 frameworks x 2 services x 2 tasks displays 8 cells
Matrix choices preserved while switching main tabs and during catalog polling
Current campaign shows 36 records, passed 16, partial 10, failed 10, pending assistant review 0, requests 331
List pagination shows 12 rows and 3 pages, including second page
Framework plus model filtering returns 4 records; unmatched search displays an empty state
Comparison view contains 9 configuration rows and 36 result cells, mutually exclusive with the list
A comparison cell opens its historical run, with screenshot-linked original model replies
Detail navigation supports previous, next and return without resetting result scope
Historical execution phone model and software information visible in Judgment and Environment
Raw detail exposes JSON and image evidence export links
Unsaved review text survives switching detail tabs; draft canceled without changing review
Narrow result list uses cards with visible detail actions
